channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: GhostChunks
item.description: Highly performant distant terrain LOD renderer, capable of rendering at 200+ fps!

item.title: Seraph Leveling ReClassed
item.description: Level up and gain traits in a vanilla-friendly way, with additional mod support

item.title: BATS!
item.description: Adds realistic flying bats to the game (They don't get stuck!). Also, renewable saltpeter.

item.title: War Without Reason
item.description: PvP has consequences. Even in safe zones.

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: Rope Arrow
item.description: Adds a new tool called "Rope Arrow" to the game that releases a climbable rope.

item.title: Pipeworks
item.description: Real bathrooms: cast a tub, run hot water, take a bath, and use the toilet before it's too late.

item.title: [Infinitum] Prospecting HUD
item.description: Prospecting HUD with reading history, ore icons, and result comparisons.

item.title: Packrat + MoreInventorys Compat
item.description: Makes MoreInventorys contents show up in Packrat's hotkey window, and adds quick stack and sorting.

item.title: Smart TV
item.description: This mod adds a flat screen wall mounted tv that is resizable. Only available in the creative menu

item.title: Smart TV Darcade
item.description: An arcade add-on for Smart TV.

item.title: Faster Barrel Recipes
item.description: Fast Barrels

item.title: Waypoint Compass
item.description: Copper, bronze or steel compass watch: HUD compass with cardinals, waypoints and players.

item.title: Boric Alchemy
item.description: Welcome to the alchemists' guild <3

item.title: Flowerbeds
item.description: Flowerbeds and arrangements to liven up your gardens.

item.title: Sliding Gates
item.description: 3x3 sliding barn and farm gates with animated leaves, padlock support and room detection.

item.description: sends modlist before queue, instead of after. also saves queue position for 10 mins (cfgable)

item.title: Niltrias's Sinister Cookery
item.description: Low-effort AI mod built for personal server only. Should not be used by anyone.

item.title: LTO Black Smith +
item.description: Toolsmith + Smithing Plus + Weaponsmith and more — a full blacksmithing overhaul.

item.title: Immersive Wakes
item.description: Wakes and splashes on water.

item.title: Cocktail Madness!
item.description: Allows for the mixing of alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages.

item.title: traduccion de mods a español LA
item.description: traduccion de mods a español LA

item.description: Heritable genetics for vanilla animals: traits improve or worsen each generation
